text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Curren Chan is training hard for her second Sprinters Stakes.
However, this time, that isn't the only thing on her mind—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother,
about today's training..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis,
about today's training...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I'd like to ask for that too, but...
would it be alright if we wrapped up a little early?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make sure it's packed with great content to make up for it!
Is that okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I haven't finished editing the video for UmaTube yet.
I really want to upload it by the end of the day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Last night's 'Umasta-Umatter Double Livestream'
got way too hype, and now I'm paying the price!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the “Cute Derby,” she's been super busy
running all her social media accounts during this time.
However, whenever I try to help out...
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: As long as you listen to my request from earlier, it'll all be fine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
let's do our best in training today too♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Curren Chan finished her scheduled
training well ahead of time and left with a bright smile...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She seems fine on the surface, but from what I know alone,
she has quite a heavy workload.
Is she really going to be all right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then one day,
an unexpected visitor came by—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(—Admire Vega. Curren Chan's senior who's active in the Twinkle Series.
And as her roommate, she's an Umamusume I often hear about.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to have something she wanted to say,
but a strange silence lingered...
However, looking as though she had made up her mind—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I came to make a complaint
about Curren-san."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"She's been staying up all night lately,
and it's a real nuisance."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, she's been glued to her smartphone
or computer the whole time, and it's making me worry."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...She usually chatters away loud enough to drive me crazy,
yet now she hasn't said a single word."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan is a perfectionist.
That's why she won't show it, but it seems she's overexerting and pushing herself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Your job is managing Umamusume, isn't it?
Do you call this doing your job?
What if she collapses out there?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ah...?! No, it's not!
This is a formal complaint!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, if you're her Trainer,
manage her properly."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega had left...
when I spotted something shining on top of the shelf near the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This likely belongs to Admire Vega.
I have to go after her...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—And in the end, unable to find Ayabe,
you came to rely on me, the Ritto Dorm head.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I understand the situation.
Still, for that Ayabe to...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! So that's it... I see.
She's so clumsy with her feelings too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Even if it's regarding your trainee,
you do know the rule that Trainers generally cannot
enter the dormitory, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I can no longer
guide you myself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—By the way... being a dorm leader
is far tougher than people think."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Who knows, I might just... doze off for the next 10 minutes."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...To tell you the truth, I've been concerned about Curren as well."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*knock knock*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
............
I waited for a while, but there was no reply.
In fact, there wasn't a single sound at all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Your job is managing Umamusume, isn't it?
Do you call this doing your job?
What if she collapses out there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something might have happened to Curren Chan!
I hurried to open the door. And there—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ......*sleeping softly*...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nnh? Big brother...?
......

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nnh? Big sister...?
......

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Big Brother!?
What are you doing here!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Big Sister!?
What are you doing here!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —I see, Ayabe-san was... So Fuji-san was worried about her too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Curren, you're not looking cool at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still... Ayabe-san, "forgetting" your key on purpose?
You're so roundabout... ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you worry too, Big Brother.
Curren's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry too, Big Sis.
Curren's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Glancing around the room, it was neatly organized,
except for a hidden stash of
energy drinks and coffee cans gathered out of sight...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, cardboard boxes labeled "For Giveaway Project"
are also piled up. Curren Chan seems to be doing
a lot more wide-ranging work than I imagined.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...You've got that look on your face
that says, "Don't push yourself too hard."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Earlier... I was just dozing off because I was editing UmaTube videos until late last night.
So it's no big deal...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I'd love to just smile through it,
but that might be pushing it a bit this time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even though I decided on it myself,
between training, classes, and relentlessly updating social media...
it feels like I'm being way too greedy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Big Brother.
Right now... I want you to let Curren push herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Big Sister.
Right now... I want you to let Curren push herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's goal is still far away.
So she can't stop until she gets there.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I... refuse to compromise on the dream I decided on,
and I refuse to lose to it, either!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...And besides!
You told me during our New Year's shrine visit, big bro."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...And besides!
You told me during our New Year's shrine visit, big sis."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That "Curren can become a champion"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though, it won't affect the race.
Besides... this project is just Curren being selfish.
I'm not gonna ask you to tag along.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “――No, I'll come with you!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If it's you, you can surely become the champion."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "‘If it's you, you can surely become the champion.’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"This is the turning point.
So please, let Curren do this her way!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Is it... no good?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren will push herself recklessly.
Pushing harder and harder...
But I will never, ever let anyone see me tired again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Are you sure that's okay, Onii-chan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Are you sure that's okay, Onee-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a Trainer, I should probably stop her. Breaking down here would defeat the whole purpose, and emotionally, I really wanted her to rest right now. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From all our time together, I already knew
that simply believing in Curren Chan was the best support I could possibly give her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother.
Curren will definitely see this through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sister.
Curren will definitely see this through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Bro~ther!
How did you like Curren's run just now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis~!
How was Curren's run just now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪
Praise me, praise me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, having made it through the critical stretch,
a smiling Curren Chan was on the training track,
showing her usual sharp form—
